pairs: Angelo Ephesi ecclesiæ scribe: Hæc dicit,
“And to the Angel of the Church of Ephesus write:
qui tenet septem stellas in dextera sua, qui ambulat in medio septem candelabrorum aureorum:
Thus says the One who holds the seven stars in his right hand, who walks in the midst of the seven golden lampstands:
et quia non potes sustinere malos:
and that you cannot stand those who are evil.
you have tested those who declare themselves to be Apostles
and you have found them to be liars.
et patientiam habes, et sustinuisti propter nomen meum,
And you have patient endurance for the sake of my name,
and you have not fallen away.
But I have this against you:
that you have relinquished your first charity.
call to mind the place from which you have fallen,
et movebo candelabrum tuum de loco suo,
I will come to you and remove your lampstand from its place,
that you hate the deeds of the Nicolaitans,
let him hear what the Spirit says to the Churches.
Vincenti dabo edere de ligno vitæ,
To him who prevails, I will give to eat from the Tree of Life,
quod est in paradiso Dei mei.
which is in the Paradise of my God.
And to the Angel of the Church of Smyrna write:
Scio tribulationem tuam, et paupertatem tuam,
I know your tribulation and your poverty,
et blasphemaris ab his, qui se dicunt Judæos esse, et non sunt,
and that you are blasphemed by those who declare themselves to be Jews and are not,
but who are a synagogue of Satan.
Nihil horum timeas quæ passurus es.
You should fear nothing amid those things which you will suffer.
Ecce missurus est diabolus aliquos ex vobis in carcerem ut tentemini:
Behold, the devil will cast some of you into prison, so that you may be tested.
And you will have tribulation for ten days.
Esto fidelis usque ad mortem, et dabo tibi coronam vitæ.
Be faithful even unto death, and I will give to you the crown of life.
let him hear what the Spirit says to the Churches.
he shall not be harmed by the second death.
And to the Angel of the Church of Pergamus write:
Hæc dicit qui habet rhomphæam utraque parte acutam:
Thus says he who holds the sharp two-edged spear:
where the seat of Satan is,
and that you hold to my name and have not denied my faith,
even in those days when Antipas was my faithful witness,
Et in diebus illis Antipas testis meus fidelis,
qui occisus est apud vos ubi Satanas habitat.
But I have a few things against you.
quia habes illic tenentes doctrinam Balaam,
For you have, in that place, those who hold to the doctrine of Balaam,
qui docebat Balac mittere scandalum coram filiis Israël,
who instructed Balak to cast a stumbling block before the sons of Israel,
to eat and to commit fornication.
ita habes et tu tenentes doctrinam Nicolaitarum.
And you also have those who hold to the doctrine of the Nicolaitans.
So do penance to the same extent.
et pugnabo cum illis in gladio oris mei.
I will come to you quickly and I will fight against these ones with the sword of my mouth.
let him hear what the Spirit says to the Churches.
To him who prevails, I will give the hidden manna.
And I will give to him a white emblem,
et in calculo nomen novum scriptum,
and on the emblem, a new name has been written,
except the one who receives it.
And to the Angel of the Church of Thyatira write:
Thus says the Son of God,
qui habet oculos tamquam flammam ignis,
who has eyes like a flame of fire,
and his feet are like shining brass.
et opera tua novissima plura prioribus.
and that your more recent works are greater than the earlier ones.
But I have a few things against you.
For you permit the woman Jezebel,
and to eat the food of idolatry.
Et dedi illi tempus ut pœnitentiam ageret:
And I gave her a time, so that she might do penance,
et non vult pœnitere a fornicatione sua.
but she is not willing to repent from her fornication.
I will cast her onto a bed,
and those who commit adultery with her shall be in a very great tribulation,
nisi pœnitentiam ab operibus suis egerint.
unless they repent from their works.
Et filios ejus interficiam in morte,
And I will put her sons to death,
et scient omnes ecclesiæ, quia ego sum scrutans renes, et corda:
and all the Churches shall know that I am the one who examines temperaments and hearts.
et dabo unicuique vestrum secundum opera sua.
And I will give to each one of you according to your works.
and to the others who are at Thyatira:
Whoever does not hold to this doctrine,
et qui non cognoverunt altitudines Satanæ,
and who has not ‘known the depths of Satan,’
non mittam super vos aliud pondus:
I will not set any other weight upon you.
Even so, that which you have,
hold on to it until I return.
et custodierit usque in finem opera mea,
and will observe my works even unto the end,
I will give to him authority over the nations.
et reget eas in virga ferrea,
And he shall rule them with an iron rod,
and they shall be broken like the earthenware of a potter.
sicut et ego accepi a Patre meo:
The same I also have received from my Father.
And I will give to him the morning star.
let him hear what the Spirit says to the Churches.”
